title: HtmlReorderRequestV1
description: One explicitly approved permutation of the element children of ONE parent in a static HTML source (docs/13, source HTML fix). The platform resolves the reviewer's opaque node ids to parentPath / orderedChildIndexes. The renderer reorders the DOM siblings on a copy, removes only the siblings' own inline `order` declarations when they merely encoded the approved visual order, re-renders, and refuses anything ambiguous.

maxVisualDiffRatio.description: fraction of differing pixels, among the non-background pixels of the screenshots of the original and the corrected source, that is still accepted (0.02 = 2 percent of the content pixels)

content.description: The job's content selection (see html-renderer-request); applied to both renders so the visual comparison covers the printed content only. The source copy is still mutated in full.
